## Anacite Ambassador (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
LN Medium construct  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +6 natural)  
**hp** 72 (8d10+28)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +5, **Will** +3  
**Immune** construct traits  
**Weaknesses** light dependency  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +9 (2d6+1)  
**Ranged** retractable laser +12 (3d6 fire plus 1d6 burn)  
**Special Attacks** burn (DC 14)  


**Tactics**


**During Combat** When diplomatic outreach fails, the anacite ambassador tries to stay out of melee range and fires its laser.  

**Morale** If reduced to fewer than 14 hit points, the anacite ambassador flees.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 12, **Dex** 17, Con—, **Int** 19, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 22  
**Feats** Skill Focus (Bluff ), Skill Focus (Diplomacy), Toughness, Weapon Focus (retractable laser)  
**Skills** Appraise +12, Bluff +17, Diplomacy +17, Knowledge (local) +15, Perception +9, Sense Motive +12  
**Languages** Common, plus three additional languages  
**SQ** ambassador protocol, language assimilation  


**Special Abilities**


**Ambassador Protocol (Ex)** Bluff, Diplomacy, Knowledge (local), and Sense Motive are class skills for an anacite ambassador.  

**Language Assimilation (Ex)** An anacite can learn a language by spending 1 day listening to it and reading it. An anacite ambassador can store knowledge of up to four languages at a time in this way, and it can choose which language to replace when it wants to learn a new one.  

**Light Dependency (Ex)** An anacite ambassador can acquire power from dim or brighter light, and it can store power generated in this way. The anacite can operate in darkness for 2 hours. After this time, the anacite gains the sickened condition until it returns to an area of dim or brighter light.  

**Retractable Laser (Ex)** An anacite ambassador’s retractable laser has a range increment of 90 feet. When not in use, this weapon is folded inside the anacite’s arm and hidden from sight. A creature unaware of the anacite’s hidden weapon must succeed at a DC 24 Perception check to find its compartment. The anacite can deploy or retract this weapon as a swift action or as part of making an attack or full attack. The weapon is mounted and leaves the anacite’s hands free, and the anacite can’t be disarmed of it. While deployed, the laser can be sundered.  

**Shortwave (Ex)** An anacite can communicate telepathically, but only with other anacites or with creatures that have shortwave communication.
